# EVI Industries Expands Florida Presence with Acquisition of Commercial Laundry Equipment Company


November 09, 2026 9:00 am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_b0d022e4c7dfa1af06d98e16045a450c/envirostarinc/news/2026-11-09_EVI_Industries_Expands_Florida_Presence_with_166.pdf)


MIAMI--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- EVI Industries, Inc. (NYSE American: “EVI”) announced today that it entered into and closed a definitive agreement to acquire West Palm Beach, Florida-based Third Phase Venture, Inc. d/b/a Commercial Laundry Equipment Company (“CLZ”), a distributor of commercial laundry products and provider of related installation and maintenance services. CLZ represents the thirty-third (33rd) commercial laundry business, and the thirty-fourth (34th) business overall, to join the EVI family.


CLZ is a second-generation, family-owned laundry distributor and service provider, led by Zachary and Stephanie Staley and Holly Ortman. Supported by its eighteen (18) dedicated employees, CLZ has earned a strong reputation for dependable service. The addition of CLZ deepens EVI’s presence in Florida. Through EVI’s continued deployment of technologies and operating systems designed to improve efficiency, speed, and scalability across its enterprise, CLZ is expected to benefit from enhanced operational capabilities that promote growth and support an even stronger customer experience.


Henry Nahmad, EVI’s Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, said, “CLZ represents exactly the type of business we seek to partner with — a well-managed company with deep customer relationships, a strong local reputation, and an experienced team positioned for growth. Zach is an exceptional next-generation leader with significant runway ahead, and we’re proud to welcome him and the entire CLZ organization to the EVI family.”


Zachary Staley, CLZ President, said, “CLZ has a long history as a family-owned business focused on customer relationships and excellent service. As the next generation of leadership at CLZ, we see EVI as the ideal partner to accelerate our growth, preserving our core business philosophies while adding the resources and support to elevate our customer experience.”


Mr. Nahmad added, “This acquisition reaffirms our unwavering commitment to the commercial laundry industry, which remains the foundation of EVI. While our new garment care services division broadens our reach, our buy-and-build strategy in commercial laundry continues at full speed, and there is more to come.”


Consistent with EVI’s operating model, CLZ will continue to operate under its existing name, from its current facility, with its team in place. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.


**EVI’s Buy and Build Philosophy**


Key components of EVI’s buy-and-build strategy include:


- Identify and partner with great businesses led by influential leaders,
- Retain the leadership team, honor the company culture and empower them,
- Collaborate on new and transformative ideas to foster a spirit of growth and innovation,
- Pursue aggressive growth plans and help the leadership team achieve their goals, and
- Create an ownership culture by motivating the team with long-term equity.


**About EVI Industries**


EVI Industries, Inc. (NYSE American: EVI), through its subsidiaries, operates in the commercial laundry distribution and consumer garment care services industries. EVI’s commercial laundry businesses sell or lease equipment, supply parts and accessories, and provide design, installation, maintenance, repair and related services to commercial, industrial, institutional, governmental and retail customers. EVI’s consumer garment care operations provide cleaning, pressing, alteration, restoration and related services for apparel and household textiles through retail and pickup-and-delivery operations. EVI pursues a long-term buy-and-build strategy focused on developing businesses, investing in people and capabilities, and creating shareholder value.
